newsitem.title: POLAND: Kredyt share assimilation seen delayed.
newsitem.headline: Kredyt share assimilation seen delayed.

text.p: The 5.6-million-share issue in Polish Kredyt Bank SA due to enter the Warsaw bourse on September 16 will likely be delayed, the bourse's president said on Friday.
Bourse President Wieslaw Rozlucki said the assimilation would likely not immediately take place because the National Securities Depositary (KDPW) was blocking it.
"According to our information the assimilation will not take place," Rozlucki said.

KDPW President Elzbieta Pustola told Reuters that the assimilation was not possible because the issue was contested by Dutch firm Hollimpex, which was allotted no shares from the issue that took place in late February and early March.
Kredyt Bank earlier said in a statement that Hollimpex sought to annul the issue in court because of faults it saw in the manner for which shares could be paid.
No one at Kredyt Bank was available for comment.
"The assimilation will take place if the court rules in Kredyt Bank's favour," Pustola said.
Belgium's Kredietbank took up 1.4 million of the issue's shares, with Budimex taking 1.2 million shares. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
